import re

def word_count(s):
    # Preprocess the text
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z\s]', '', s)
    s = s.lower()
    
    # Tokenize the text into words
    words = s.split()
    
    # Define the excluded words
    excluded_words = ["a", "the", "on", "at", "of", "upon", "in", "as"]
    
    # Exclude the excluded words
    filtered_words = [word for word in words if word not in excluded_words]
    
    # Count the remaining words
    return len(filtered_words)

    exclude_words = ['a', 'the', 'on', 'at', 'of', 'upon', 'in', 'as']

    cleaned_s = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z\s]', '', s).lower()
    # Split the cleaned string into words
    words = cleaned_s.split()

    filtered_words = [word for word in words if word not in exclude_words]

    return len(filtered_words)
